name: Sparse Octree Filtering with Node Map
definition: A 2D node map derived from the light-view map, acting as a MIP-map pyramid, to reduce the number of threads launched during filtering by terminating redundant threads.
summary: Sparse Octree Filtering with Node Map is a thread-synchronization heuristic that prevents redundant computation by using a 2D MIP-map hierarchy to identify common ancestors and terminate all but the upper-left thread.
